MONTHLY CONDITION REPORT
Machine 12-P-101 was surveyed on 14 March. Overall vibration has risen
since the previous route, from 2.1 mm/s to 3.4 mm/s. The analyst notes
an increase at running speed and recommends a repeat reading in 30 days.
Bearing temperatures were normal throughout.
